- Typical costs: One agency guide says freelance Lovable developers typically charge $50-150/hour or $5,000-$15,000 per project; agencies run $13,000-$25,000 for a full production build.

Summary returned: Two separate episodes. 1. CVE-2025-48757 (2025): misconfigured RLS in user-built apps. A security researcher scanned 1,645 applications from Lovable's own showcase and found 170 of them (10.3%) had critical RLS failures. Attackers needed no login: the public anon_key embedded in the client allowed direct queries to Supabase. Exposed data included contact details, payment and subscription status, and API keys. Severity scores differ (CVSS 8.26 in some, 9.3 in others). 2. April 2026 platform bug reported by @weezerOSINT: a backend regression (BOLA-type) active Feb 3 to Apr 20, 2026, meant anyone with a link to a public Lovable project could read chat history and source code. Bastion's write-up claims broader scope (projects created before November 2025) - treat cautiously. A February 2026 incident exposed 18,697 user records in a featured app, which one source attributes to an inverted authentication check. Several results are vendor marketing pages.
